spots.text: HERE LIE THE READERS WHO FINISHED. There are not very many of them.

meta.label: The Moss Cathedral
meta.blurb: Nobody has preached here in a long time, and the congregation is moss. It sits very still, in every pew, and listens.

secrets.name: The Crypt
secrets.text: Behind the altar a stair goes down under the floor. The dead are shelved here like everyone else, and someone keeps their candles lit.
